clue.text: At university overlook the cost

parts.note: to be up is to be in residence at university
to overlook in its older sense is to oversee, to keep watch over

explanation.surface: A student ignores how much it all costs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overlook' reads as ignore, but here it means watch over, as a keeper guards a castle.
explanation.definitionFit: Upkeep is the ongoing expense of maintaining something, its running cost.

clue.text: Covering film classification which includes language not now used

indicators.note: the film rating holds the dead language within its two letters

parts.note: PG is the Parental Guidance film certificate
Latin is a dead language, no longer spoken

explanation.surface: A film's rating covers its use of an archaic tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: Plating is a thin metal coating laid over a surface.

clue.text: name

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'name (4)': cut short, only one word survives, no wordplay to annotate.

clue.text: Biblical character played harp I understand

indicators.note: the harp and I are performed in a new arrangement, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: 'I see' means I understand

explanation.surface: Someone recalls a Bible figure performing on the harp.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pharisees were a Jewish sect prominent in the Gospels.

clue.text: Tyne flows round it, showing essential nature

indicators.note: the rearranged river surrounds the small word it
a river flowing churns, so the river's name is rearranged

explanation.surface: The river Tyne swirls around something, revealing its true character.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flows' rearranges the river's name to ENTY; 'round' wraps those letters about IT, so the river is the fodder, not the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An entity is a thing's being or existence, its essential nature in philosophy.

clue.text: Former English member with time will be not liable

parts.note: ex- means former
MP, Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: An ex-MP from England will in time escape responsibility.
explanation.definitionFit: Exempt means free from an obligation, not subject to it.

clue.text: Method used by college's unique, university doesn't get a look in

parts.note: a tech is a technical college

indicators.note: the university's letter is shut out of the word unique

explanation.surface: A technical college's special approach shuts out the university.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doesn't get a look in' removes U from UNIQUE, leaving NIQUE.
explanation.definitionFit: A technique is a particular way of doing something, a procedure.

clue.text: Picking up a bag of stolen goods involves doctor in chancy game

indicators.note: the turned letters take the doctor's letters inside
in a down clue, lifting the letters makes them read upward, so backwards

parts.note: loot is stolen booty
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A doctor gets mixed up in a risky game while collecting a sack of swag.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'Picking up' reads A LOOT upward as TOOLA; 'involves' then puts the doctor inside. 'chancy game' is the definition, not a description of theft.
explanation.definitionFit: A tombola is a raffle-style lottery drawn from a revolving drum, a game of luck.

clue.text: Play's title should be a good seller

parts.note: Brand is a verse play by Ibsen
a name is a title

explanation.surface: A theatre producer wants a catchy title to sell tickets.
explanation.definitionFit: A brand name is a trade label that makes a product sell well.

clue.text: One's work depends on getting others steamed up

definitions.text: One's work depends on getting others steamed up

parts.words: One's work depends on getting others steamed up
parts.note: sounds like someone who riles people; really a tradesman who builds the vessels that heat water into steam

explanation.surface: Someone whose job is making people angry.
explanation.definitionFit: A boilermaker builds boilers, which produce steam.

clue.text: Funny order taken in by commander-in-chief

indicators.note: the commander's letters enclose the order's letters

parts.note: OM, the Order of Merit

explanation.surface: An absurd command accepted by the top general.
explanation.definitionFit: Comic means amusing, causing laughter.

clue.text: Exuding charm is a natural response if so?

definitions.text: Exuding charm is a natural response if so?

indicators.note: the letters ooze out in a new order, signalling a rearrangement

parts.note: a tic is an involuntary twitch, a reflex

explanation.surface: Being charming comes as instinctively as a reflex.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Exuding' rearranges CHARMISA into CHARISMA, then TIC follows; read whole, the clue describes someone whose charm is a tic.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone magnetic radiates appeal so habitually it seems a reflex.

clue.text: Woman is absorbing religious instruction

indicators.note: the word is soaks up the other letters inside it

parts.note: RI, the school subject Religious Instruction

explanation.surface: A woman is taken up with Bible classes.
explanation.definitionFit: Iris is a woman's given name.

clue.text: The man's playing Pianola in Sante Domingo

parts.note: his means belonging to the man

indicators.note: the pianola is set going, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man performs on a player piano in the Caribbean.
explanation.walkthrough: Santo Domingo (printed 'Sante') was once the name of the whole island now called Hispaniola.
explanation.definitionFit: The Caribbean island shared by Haiti and the Dominican Republic was long called Santo Domingo.

clue.text: Encourage to send payment for return of kitchen clock

parts.note: to egg on is to encourage

indicators.note: the payment word comes back, read in reverse

parts.note: to remit is to send money

explanation.surface: Urging someone to pay up for the return of a stolen kitchen clock.
explanation.definitionFit: An egg timer is a small sand-glass or timer used when boiling eggs.

clue.text: Popular wire: it carries charge which varies by person

parts.note: in means fashionable, popular
flex is electrical cable
an ion is an electrically charged particle

explanation.surface: A trendy cable that carries electric current.
explanation.definitionFit: In grammar, a word's ending changes to mark first, second or third person: its inflexion.

clue.text: On reflection is a Queen put first as it were?

indicators.note: the queen's letters go at the front of the answer

parts.note: QU is a chess or card abbreviation for queen

indicators.note: a mirror reflection reverses, so the words is a are read backwards

explanation.surface: Musing whether a queen is put first, so to speak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On reflection' turns IS A into ASI, and 'put first' places QU ahead of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Quasi means seemingly, in a manner of speaking.

clue.text: Altering wrong one?

indicators.note: the word is put wrongly together, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Asking whether a mistaken change could be the culprit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Altering' looks like the anagram signal; it is the fodder and 'wrong' does that job.
explanation.definitionFit: Integral means whole, complete, forming a single unit.

clue.text: Design test to be taken by one with frequency

parts.note: the MOT is the annual roadworthiness test for UK vehicles
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A test sat by one person often.
explanation.definitionFit: A motif is a recurring pattern or decorative figure.

clue.text: Ornament found by wife tucking into trifle

indicators.note: the wife's letter is tucked inside the trifle word

parts.note: to tiddle is to trifle or potter about

explanation.surface: A decoration found when a wife digs into a pudding.
explanation.walkthrough: A trifle here is not the British layered dessert but the verb, to fiddle about.
explanation.definitionFit: A twiddle is a decorative flourish or curl.

clue.text: It could be used to inform of a spell of winter coming

definitions.text: It could be used to inform

indicators.note: a stretch of the letters in the two words, run on, gives the answer

explanation.surface: A warning device announces a cold snap coming.
explanation.definitionFit: An intercom is a speaker system for passing messages within a building.

clue.text: About to accept tradition about one's unit of heat

indicators.note: the folklore word goes around the letter for one

clue.text: Woman with US soldier's given ring in slow movement

parts.note: Ada is a woman's name
a GI is an American soldier
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: A woman gets an engagement ring from a GI during a slow dance.
explanation.definitionFit: Adagio is a musical tempo marking, and a piece played slowly.

clue.text: Cutter moves slowly in positions of danger

parts.note: a knife cuts
to edge is to inch forward

explanation.surface: A blade is gradually advanced towards peril.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on a knife-edge means being in a precarious state.

clue.text: Liberal involved in soft drug conspiracy

indicators.note: the party letter goes inside the drug word

parts.note: pot is cannabis

explanation.surface: A Liberal politician mixed up in a cannabis scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: A plot is a secret scheme, a conspiracy.

clue.text: English composer almost has merit

indicators.note: almost the whole name: the composer loses his last letter

parts.note: Thomas Arne, English composer of Rule, Britannia

explanation.surface: An English composer nearly deserves praise.
explanation.definitionFit: To earn is to deserve, to merit by effort.

clue.text: Artist on day 2 shows features of circle

explanation.surface: A painter's second day shows round shapes.

clue.text: Tragic ire could be shown by the elderly

indicators.note: the letters could be displayed in another order, a rearrangement

explanation.surface: Old people may display tragic rage.
explanation.definitionFit: Geriatric describes old age and the care of old people.

clue.text: Lion eats termite in shed

indicators.note: the lion swallows the insect, holding it inside

parts.note: Leo is the lion of the zodiac
a termite is often called a white ant

explanation.surface: A lion devours an insect inside a hut.
explanation.definitionFit: A lean-to is a simple shed built against a wall.

clue.text: Old 'soldier gets clean away to right

indicators.note: the clean letters are sent away in disorder, a rearrangement
